use_case_summary: Large retail catalog (current catalog ~38M SKUs across regions). Primary need: semantic product search + reranking to boost conversion on ambiguous queries and category landing pages. Strong focus on minimizing cost-per-query while keeping tail latency low during marketing spikes.
notes:
- Account snapshot: fast-growing omnichannel retailer, complex catalog (variants, bundles, localized copy).
- Business ask: replace rule-based relevance; expected 8-12% lift in add-to-cart from better relevance.
- Technical constraints:
  * Index size target: 30-50M item vectors (store dense embeddings + metadata).
  * Latency targets: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 150ms for rerank stage under steady load; during seasonal peaks p95 < 300ms acceptable if graceful degradation.
  * Cost target: target end-to-end incremental cost per query <= $0.0025 at 10 qps steady; at 100 qps (peak) acceptable up to $0.006.
  * Throughput: need ability to handle 10-15x baseline traffic for Black Friday/Cyber week (burst autoscale + reserved capacity).
- Current POC: running Redwood hosted embeddings + local reranker prototype. Initial results: 1M index, relevance NR on head queries, latency p95 180ms; cost unknown when scaled.
- Wants: batching strategy suggestions, quantized reranker recommendations, prefix caching for popular queries, smart routing to cheaper model variants at non-peak hours.
- Security & compliance: must support SSO (SAML), KMS integration for key management, audit logs for all inference requests, and 7 year retention of logs for compliance team. Data residency: US + EU (regional indexes).
- SE feedback: Marcus suggests Dedicated pool with autoscale + pre-warmed nodes for holiday spikes; implement tiered fallback models (small quantized reranker for tail).
- Quote from head of search (product): "We need predictable economics when traffic spikes — can't be surprised by a 5x bill increase during promotions."
- Risks: indexing latencies for reindexing nightly feeds (catalog updates ~200k changes/day), embedding churn and cost of frequent re-embeds.
- Next tacticals: run 50M vector ingest dry-run, capture cost-per-query projections using Redwood Optimize, schedule security KMS workshop w/ infra (week of 2026-03-15).
